message: 世界を救う者

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whew! Exams are finally over, and I feel totally refreshed!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It feels as though a weight has been lifted from my chest!」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, how can Student Council officers act so irresponsible」

name: Macaron
message: 「Exams are such a great chance to show off what you can really do, though」

name: Synn
message: 「That's certainly one positive way to look at it」

name: Ria
message: 「So... what brings you here, Macaron-chan?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um... kind of like Big Brother's guardian?」

name: Synn
message: 「She just got off her part-time job and has time to kill」

name: Macaron
message: 「I do not have time to kill!」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's been worried about Synn-sama since this morning, you know」

name: Macaron
message: 「N-No I haven't!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I just... couldn't take my eyes off the panda!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh? The great me has zero interest in flat-chested girls」

name: Macaron
message: 「Honestly, are you black on white? Or white on black?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that's...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't we peel him and find out?」

name: Misa
message: 「T-T-That kind of cruelty wouldn't even be allowed on TV!」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, I might be a little curious...」

name: Paqy
message: 「By Ria-chan's own hands, by all means!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sebastian ought to have some good hair removal cream」

name: Synn
message: 「Sounds like cleaning up would be a pain」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here you go then, Mako-chan. He says you can pluck him」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoooaaa!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「N-No, it's fine! It'd totally ruin your handsome face, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-You actually get it, huh……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, isn't that the very reason your little sister came here?」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's why I'm watching for an opening on Big Brother!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A sneak attack!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek! Is that what's going on!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Well, something like that?」

name: Misa
message: 「No, Macaron! Fighting fair and square is the golden rule of any match!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, n-no, that's not what I meant!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um, I thought if Big Brother left himself open, I'd cover for him」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my, what a sweet little sister you have」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's way too good of a little sister for Synn~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry about that」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, I just gotta act natural, act natural……」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm gonna observe Big Brother and the others carefully and find their weak spots!」

name: Helena
message: 「Good day, members of the Student Council!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Uwahya!? Wh-Wh-What is that!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, Big Sister, when did you……」

name: Helena
message: 「Today, I have an important matter to discuss with you all」

name: Macaron
message: 「A-A weird box is talking in Big Sister Helena's voice……?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what you call a marvel of modern civilization」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Sister Helena is folded up inside this thing……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, definitely not.」

name: Helena
message: 「However, due to the complexity of the matter, it cannot be fully explained here.」

name: Helena
message: 「Therefore, you are ordered to report to the Director's office!」

name: Misa
message: 「Roundabout as always, isn't she...」

name: Helena
message: 「Furthermore, once this message ends, this tape will self-destruct♪」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eeeh!? A-baba, self-destruct!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's her usual routine.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh no! We have to run, hurry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, I'm telling you, it's fine...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Everyone, what are you standing around for!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, you know...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eeeh!? It's going back up!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that's how it's gonna go……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Waaah!? It's gonna explode after all!」

name: Helena
message: 「Kaboooooom!!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Waaaaah! Big Brotheeeer!」

name: Helena
message: 「……Just kiiiidding\s07」

name: Macaron
message: 「Waaaah! I'm gonna diiiie!」

name: Synn
message: 「……Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Uwaaah, aah……」

name: Macaron
message: 「H-How was that, some masterful acting!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Shall we go see Helena」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse meee」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, big sis Helena! That surprised you, didn't it!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, welcome. Macaron-chan is with you too, I see」

name: Macaron
message: 「I thought my heart was gonna burst out of my chest!」

name: Helena
message: 「Mfufu, everyone's reactions have been so dull lately, this is wonderfully refreshing~」

name: Helena
message: 「Leave it to me, Macaron-chan. Next time I'll put even more effort into it\s04」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nooooooo!」

name: Ria
message: 「So, what's this important talk about?」

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be something related to the Re-Crea?」

name: Helena
message: 「You're quick on the uptake--that makes things easier. You two, please explain.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Leaving the troublesome part to others, I see.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, Amyrina.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are Melilot-san and Emi-chan here?」

name: Helena
message: 「Actually, I've had the two of them helping out in various ways with the Re-Crea investigation.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's news to me!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I only shared what I happened to know, that's all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Without further ado, allow me to get straight to the point.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Have you all noticed the recent anomalies occurring in Ryuusei Town?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm, the number of shooting stars falling has been increasing, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I also feel like the Demons we run into on patrol have been getting stronger」

name: Misa
message: 「Encounters have been getting more frequent too, haven't they」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And you're saying that's all because of Re-Crea?」

name: Melilot
message: 「To put it simply, yes」

name: Helena
message: 「The timing when Re-Crea activates……」

name: Helena
message: 「In other words, the peak period of Re-Crea is fast approaching」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you come here to tell us that?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's part of it, but what I want to talk about right now is something else entirely」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You are not the only ones considering countermeasures against Re-Crea」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Actually, an investigation team was also dispatched from Heaven to observe Re-Crea, however……」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A few days ago, we lost contact with one of its members」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Due to Re-Crea's activity intensifying, the investigation team was supposed to have returned to Heaven, yet……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could that person be someone we know……?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I wasn't told as far as their name……」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is something even more puzzling」

name: Melilot
message: 「The current progression speed of Re-Crea doesn't match any past observation data we have……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Rather, there are even signs that the discrepancies from past phenomena are growing stronger」

name: Ria
message: 「So things that wouldn't normally happen are happening……」

name: Helena
message: 「Exactly」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, does that mean……?」

name: Helena
message: 「There's a high chance someone is intentionally orchestrating these changes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're saying someone is trying to trigger Re-Crea on purpose!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is still strictly at the stage of a possibility, though」

name: Helena
message: 「Things at work probably didn't go well for them, so they got fed up with this world」

name: Misa
message: 「What a massive nuisance……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If we reset the world over every little thing like that, we wouldn't even have time to eat.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Jeez, Lolotte...」

name: Synn
message: 「So, we have to be careful of whoever that is, then.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, that would be the case.」

name: Helena
message: 「But you don't need to worry!」

name: Helena
message: 「Because we have the Demon Lord for times like this!」

name: Synn
message: 「The Demon Lord!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh, what? Did you call me?」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Helena
message: 「Originally, the Demon Lord is the one who bears the role of safely bringing Re-Crea to an end.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ho-ho.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, is that true?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh? Didn't I tell ya?」

name: Helena
message: 「To us, the Demon Lord is, so to speak, a hero of salvation!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「O-Oh, right! The Demon Lord is totally a HERO!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihahaha...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wonder if Master was fighting that Re-Crea thing in the Human World too...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even though they never said a single word about it...」

name: Ria
message: 「The Demon Lord is someone who appears every time Re-Crea happens and saves the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that ya mention it, maybe I didn't say anything.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um... a-are you guys counting on me?」

name: Helena
message: 「If Macaron-chan really is the Demon Lord, then to us, you're truly our savior!」

name: Helena
message: 「I really would like your cooperation in stopping the Re-Crea」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, if you put it like that, I guess I have no choice!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Just leave everything to the great Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't really get what this Re-Crea thing is all about, though……」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh yeah, if it's Macaron, we're in safe hands」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are we really going to be okay with the boss of the Warusaders, who can't even beat the Crusaders?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Grrr! I'll beat them eventually!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, I told you we're not the Warusaders!」

name: Misa
message: 「I suppose that means we should prepare ourselves mentally for now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If we all work together, we won't lose to something like the Re-Crea!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, yes, that's the spirit!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone, please be careful not to let your guard down」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm gonna save the world, so it'll be totally fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Sigh*……」

name: Helena
message: 「If I find out anything else, I'll let you know」

name: Helena
message: 「Please keep up the good work with your Crusaders duties」

name: Melilot
message: 「……Helena. Was it really alright to egg her on like that?」

name: Helena
message: 「About what?」

name: Melilot
message: 「About Macaron」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, right……」

name: Helena
message: 「If she ends up fulfilling her role as the true Demon Lord, then wouldn't that solve everything?」

name: Melilot
message: 「And what will you do if that doesn't happen」

name: Helena
message: 「There's really nothing we can do~」

name: Melilot
message: 「How irresponsible...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, when that time comes, all we can do is pray, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「That the real Demon Lord shows up for us...」

name: Synn
message: 「The sunset sure is bright~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Everyone's counting on me, aren't they」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah, yeah! I've gotta do my best and become a splendid Demon Lord as fast as I can!」

name: Macaron
message: 「And then, with Big Brother too...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. Why didn't you step forward and say you're the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, I've kept quiet about it to everyone all this time...」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't just come out and say it the second we find out the Demon Lord isn't the bad guy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Too late now, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, Macaron is working so hard at it, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way I could tell her that I'm the real Demon Lord when I haven't put in any effort at all」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Well, if you're fine with that, Demon Lord, then whatever」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's wrong, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, I was just spacing out a little」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, don't blame me if you trip and fall!」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't fall...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, let's hurry home!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」
...Yeah, that's right.
I never have to tell anyone that I'm the Demon Lord.
It's fine if it stays a secret from everyone.
Even with Re-Crea, if we all work together, I'm sure we'll manage somehow.
If Macaron just becomes the Demon Lord, there won't be any problems at all……
